To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“A next generation information gathering agent should be able to reason about its information gathering activities in order to maximize the quality of its decisions.”

(1) the use of information extraction and information integration techniques can greatly reduce the amount of time and effort needed to gather information from the World Wide Web and other information sources, (2) an information gathering agent can use information extraction and integration techniques to improve its own performance, (3) an information gathering system can be used as a test bed for research in a wide variety of AI sub-fields, including planning, reasoning, machine learning, natural language processing, information extraction, information integration, and
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a system to gather information from the Web in a resource-bounded manner, to support a decision-making process.
the problem of building an information gathering agent that plans and reasons about its own activities.
the development of an intelligent agent that can plan and execute an information gathering process to support a decision making task.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the BIG system is the first to combine the following features into a single agent: a) the ability to gather information from unstructured documents and from databases, b) the ability to reason about the trade-offs of different information gathering plans, c) a knowledge-based model for the information gathering process, d) an architecture to support the development of information gathering agents, and e) an implementation of the system that has been successfully used in a number of real world applications.
BIG is a system that plans and reasons about the resource costs of different approaches to information gathering, and uses this information to select the best approach.
BIG is an agent that can plan, reason, and act in an information gathering environment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
BIG is a resource-bounded agent that plans to gather and process information to make decisions.
we have developed a new approach to information gathering that is based on the integration of planning, reasoning, and information extraction technologies.
we have developed a new information gathering agent, which is capable of planning, reasoning, and learning.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a single agent-based architecture is a viable approach to integrating several areas of AI research and to building complex, real-world systems.
the information explosion is a problem that can be solved by applying the right mix of AI technologies.
a system capable of gathering information in a resource-aware manner is a necessary component of a future generation of information gathering systems.
